# Psalm 33 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Shout-for-joy in-YHWH, O-righteous; for-the-upright praise is-fitting.

**2** Give-thanks to-YHWH with-the-lyre; with-a-harp of-ten [strings] make-music to-Him.

**3** Sing to-Him a-new song; play-skillfully with-a-shout.

**4** For upright [is] the-word of-YHWH, and-all His-work [is done] in-faithfulness.

**5** He-loves righteousness and-justice; the-steadfast-love of-YHWH fills the-earth.

**6** By-the-word of-YHWH the-heavens were-made, and-by-the-breath of-His-mouth all their-host.

**7** He-gathers as-a-heap the-waters of-the-sea; He-puts in-storehouses the-deeps.

**8** Let-all the-earth fear YHWH; let-all the-inhabitants of-the-world stand-in-awe of-Him.

**9** For He spoke, and-it-was; He-commanded, and-it-stood.

**10** YHWH brings-to-nothing the-counsel of-the-nations; He-frustrates the-plans of-the-peoples.

**11** The-counsel of-YHWH stands forever, the-plans of-His-heart to-all generations.

**12** Blessed [is] the-nation whose God [is] YHWH, the-people He-has-chosen as-His-inheritance.

**13** From-heaven YHWH looks-down; He-sees all the-sons of-man.

**14** From-His-dwelling-place He-gazes upon all the-inhabitants of-the-earth,

**15** the-One-forming together their-hearts, the-One-understanding all their-deeds.

**16** A-king is-not saved by-a-great army; a-warrior is-not delivered by-great strength.

**17** A-horse [is] a-vain-hope for-salvation; by-its-great strength it-does-not deliver.

**18** Behold, the-eye of-YHWH [is] on those-who-fear-Him, on-those-who-hope in-His-steadfast-love,

**19** to-deliver their-soul from-death and-to-keep-them-alive in-famine.

**20** Our-soul waits for-YHWH; our-help and-our-shield [is] He.

**21** For in-Him our-heart rejoices, for in-His-holy name we-trust.

**22** Let-Your-steadfast-love, YHWH, be upon-us, as we-hope in-You.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **33:6**: Creation by speech — 'He spoke and it was' — the most concise statement of creatio ex nihilo in the Old Testament.

— EMET
